summary: No first-party local Kanggye registry, DPRK public cadastral viewer, or anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry service was evidenced. Search results were non-local/secondary, and direct DPRK-domain access was unsuccessful. No GeoJSON sample was retained.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Korean discovery queries are recorded in city-1630-kanggye.json. They did not identify an authoritative Kanggye parcel source.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Connection returned OpenSSL wrong-version-number; no content or service schema obtained. TLS was not disabled.
Certificate chain was not trusted by the default client; request was not retried with verification disabled.
Connection timed out after 8 seconds; no retry escalation, login, credentials, or bypass attempted.
Official Republic of Korea land-information portal found in search results; it is not a DPRK/Kanggye custodian and was not queried for parcels.
Official Gyeonggi Republic of Korea cadastral viewer found in search results; its jurisdiction excludes Kanggye and no parcel request was made.
South Korean Ministry of Unification DPRK information portal found; general country information only, no public Kanggye parcel service or geometry.
South Korean national atlas material about DPRK land/economic history; not a cadastral registry or parcel service.
